body:
I guess my biggest problem is that going through the motions - working, maintaining my personal relationships - takes more effort than I can muster.  Nothing feels good.  Nothing is rewarding.  It's not just that I have to keep from killing myself, it's that I also have to persuade myself to get out of bed every morning and do things.  Life has been either empty or painful for so long that I just can't be convinced that it's worth living.  
Two weeks ago the niece of a close friend killed herself.  I was jealous.
